description: List merchants available for agent commerce (Rappi, Good Eggs, DoorDash) and whether this user has linked each one. Link a merchant before shopping it.
name: buy_list_merchants

merchants.description: Available commerce merchants and this user's link status for each.

link_status.description: 'ready' (no account needed) or 'linked' (account linked): shop now. 'unlinked': no account linked yet. 'pending': a link was started and not finished. 'error': the last link attempt failed.

message.description: Human-readable merchant list (or an error / empty note).
